title: Strings: anagram check by counting
summary: Count each letter of the first word, then use the counts up with the second.

panels.label: counts: letter → how many are still unused

narration.text: The words have different lengths ({len(s)} and {len(t)}), so they can't be anagrams.
Both words have {len(s)} letters. Now compare the letters themselves.
Start an empty count of letters.
Next letter of the first word: {c}.
Every letter of the first word is counted.
Next letter of the second word: {c}.
Every letter of the second word was matched.
No {c} is left to use: the second word has more of it than the first.
Every letter matched exactly: they're anagrams.
